title: GridSim v1 boundaries.json
description: The transfer boundaries of the case, one record each. Optional file. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: A transfer boundary (v1 BoundaryDto): the named branches whose signed flows sum to the boundary flow. Branches are matched by name only; the last branch of a shared name wins and an unknown name is skipped (BoundaryAnalysis.Evaluate; a recorded finding). Absent: name empty, limitMw 0, no branches.

limitMw.title: Limit (MW)
limitMw.description: Transfer limit across the boundary. Absent: 0.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: The branches crossing the boundary, each with a direction. Absent: none.

boundaryBranch.title: Boundary branch
boundaryBranch.description: One branch crossing a boundary (v1 BoundaryBranchDto). Absent direction: 1.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Name of a line or transformer. Absent: empty.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: +1 counts the branch's from-to flow as positive boundary flow, -1 counts it negative. Absent: 1.
